Create a new Payment Transaction
### Permissions

| Auth Method | Required Permissions |
|---|---|
| [API Key](/developers/getting-started/authentication/#api-key-auth) | All permissions (admin access) |
| [Basic Auth](/developers/getting-started/authentication/#basic-auth) | `Can add payment requests` ([Payment Request](/business/plugins/payment-request)) or `Can add e-commerce payments` ([E-Commerce](/business/plugins/e-commerce)) |

> **Gateway permission**: `Can use pg_code` for the target [payment gateway](/developers/payments/payment-methods/)

:::info
The PUT operation cannot be used if the user does not have permission
to use the previously defined payment gateway [code](/developers/payments/payment-methods/) on the transaction.
:::

**Creating an AutoPay subscription.** Set `payment_type` to `auto_pay` and send the `autopay` block. Six things are easy to miss:

- `agreement` is a full [recurring agreement](/developers/cards-and-tokens/recurring-payments/#agreement-types), not only an id. Because the agreement `type` defaults to `recurring`, `agreement.id`, `frequency`, `amount_variability`, `cycle_interval_days`, `total_cycles` and `expiry_date` are all required. A missing field is rejected with a `400` that names it. Repeat the same schedule in the `autopay` block: the agreement is what the gateway sees, and the `autopay` block is what Ottu bills on.
- `customer_id` is required.
- `language` is optional and defaults to `en`. It sets the language of the customer's self-service page and of every customer email, and cannot be changed afterwards.
- `customer_email` is required, because every customer email goes there. A missing one returns a `400` with the error under the `autopay` key, which looks like a problem with the autopay block. Check `customer_email` first.
- `pg_codes` must name a gateway that supports tokenization and auto-debit, because Ottu charges every renewal by auto-debit against the card saved at checkout.
- `amount` is the first charge only. `"0.000"` creates a trial: the card is saved, no money moves, and the subscription starts in `trialing` instead of `active`.

The `201` response carries `extra.autopay.subscription_id`. Store it: it is your handle on the subscription. The `autopay` block is write-only and is not echoed back. Every call with `payment_type: "auto_pay"` creates a new subscription, so guard against double submits on your side. See the [AutoPay guide](/developers/payments/autopay/).


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/checkout/v1/pymt-txn/' \\\n--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY' \\\n--data '{\n  \"type\": \"e_commerce\",\n  \"amount\": \"10.000\",\n  \"currency_code\": \"KWD\",\n  \"pg_codes\": [\n    \"knet\"\n  ]\n}'"}</pre>
